title: Google\Cloud\Bigtable\Filter\ConditionFilter
name: ConditionFilter
description: Evaluates one of two filters, depending on the outcome of the predicate filter.

methods.name: then
methods.description: Adds a true filter to the condition filter. This filter will be applied if the predicate filter returns any results.

params.name: trueFilter
params.description: A filter to be evaluted when the predicate evalutes to true.

methods.name: otherwise
methods.description: Adds a false filter to condition filter. This filter will be applied if the predicate filter does not return results.

params.name: falseFilter
params.description: A filter to be evaluated when the predicate evalutes to false.
